newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end up, medium term outlook bullish.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end up, medium term outlook bullish.

text.p: Greek equities extended their winning streak to two sessions and analysts said volatility would be the norm heading into the government's policy statements on October 10 but the medium-to-long term outlook was bullish.

"The medium-to-long term market trend is upward but nervousness and volatility will prevail in the short-run as we are nearing the government's policy statements," Emmanuel Varsos, managing director at Investment Analysis, told Reuters.
The Athens general share index closed 0.55 percent, or 5.27 points higher at 965.66 from Tuesday's 960.39 close after opening at 960.76 points.
Turnover stood at 7.39 billion drachmas on volume of 4.13 million shares.
Gainers led decliners 114 to 92 with 36 issues unchanged on 242 traded. Banks gained 1.04 percent, industrials rose 0.52 percent and construction firmed 0.46 percent. Small-caps jumped 1.48 percent.
